findings.title: Completed tasks can still have an unread continuation turn
findings.description: An empty task ledger does not prove the dispatch is finished. A task notification can arrive before the human-origin result, while its parent continuation remains pending. This branch returns prematurely; the next dispatch then discards that continuation as leftover text. Reproduced with the existing scripted client: dispatch returned `"Waiting."` without reading the queued final answer. Track pending continuations or authoritative session-idle state, and add this ordering as a regression test.

findings.title: Background timeout also interrupts foreground continuation work
findings.description: Once a background-wait turn starts, `idle_s` remains applied even after a terminal notification clears the ledger and the parent resumes foreground work. A slow continuation therefore times out and returns partial text as success, contrary to the foreground-no-timer policy. Reproduced with a completed task followed by a delayed parent answer: dispatch returned only `"Starting final work."` with zero tasks stopped. Disable the background timer when foreground work resumes and test this transition.
